stories.title: Au procès de Robert Ménard pour avoir refusé de célébrer le mariage d’un homme sous OQTF, une peine d’amende requise

en.title: Robert Ménard tried for refusing to solemnize marriage of man under OQTF, fine sought
en.summary: The mayor of Béziers faced trial for refusing to marry a couple when the man was subject to a deportation order. Prosecutors requested a fine of 7,500 euros without pursuing a disqualification from office.

stories.title: Vol de FlyDubai vers Tel-Aviv détourné : Israël dénonce une "tentative d'attaque" et salue le courage du pilote

en.title: FlyDubai flight to Tel-Aviv diverted: Israel denounces "attempted attack" and praises pilot's courage
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft was diverted after an incident involving one of the pilots. Passengers described violent scenes and commended those who intervened to restrain the pilot.

stories.title: Un passager israélien du vol de Flydubai dérouté assure avoir sauvé l’avion en prenant les commandes… grâce à une émission télé

en.title: Israeli passenger on diverted FlyDubai flight claims he saved the aircraft by taking controls thanks to TV show
en.summary: An Israeli passenger entered the cockpit following an apparent attack by the co-pilot and said he attempted to stabilize the aircraft. He attributed his knowledge of how to respond to watching a television program about aviation dangers.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Vol de Flydubai dérouté : Israël dénonce une «tentative d’attaque» et salue le courage du pilote

en.title: LIVE - FlyDubai flight diverted: Israel denounces "attempted attack" and praises pilot's courage
en.summary: An aircraft bound for Tel-Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after one pilot stabbed the other and attempted to crash the plane, according to Israel's prime minister.

stories.title: «Énorme chaos», «gens hystériques», «journée folle» : des passagers racontent le vol Flydubai vers Israël dérouté

en.title: "Enormous chaos", "hysterical people", "crazy day": passengers recount Flydubai flight to Israel diverted
en.summary: A Flydubai aircraft heading to Tel-Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday after an attack occurred during the flight.

stories.title: «Incident terroriste», altercation dans le cockpit : que s’est-il passé à bord du vol Dubaï-Tel Aviv dérouté vers l’Arabie saoudite ?

en.title: "Terrorist incident", altercation in the cockpit: what happened on the Dubai-Tel Aviv flight diverted to Saudi Arabia?
en.summary: A Flydubai flight made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after a sudden nose dive and two emergency codes. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu claimed one pilot stabbed the other, with both sustaining injuries.

stories.title: Pilote poignardé, avion pour Tel-Aviv dérouté en Arabie Saoudite… Ce que l’on sait de l’attaque d’un copilote à bord d’un vol Flydubai

en.title: Pilot stabbed, aircraft to Tel-Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia... What we know about the attack on a Flydubai flight copilot
en.summary: A flight from Dubai to Israel landed in Tabuk on Wednesday after a sudden loss of altitude. While Israeli media reports an altercation between pilots and a possible terrorist act, the circumstances remain unclear.

stories.title: Pilote automatique, commandes perturbées, perte d’altitude : comment l’avion Flydubai vers Tel Aviv a-t-il pu plonger si brutalement ?

en.title: Autopilot, disrupted controls, loss of altitude: how could the Flydubai aircraft to Tel Aviv dive so suddenly?
en.summary: The Boeing 737 lost over 4,000 meters in less than thirty seconds. Netanyahu stated that one pilot attempted to crash the aircraft after stabbing the other.

stories.title: Vol Flydubai dérouté vers l’Arabie saoudite, la piste "terroriste" évoquée

en.title: Flydubai flight diverted to Saudi Arabia, 'terrorist' angle raised
en.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia after an incident where one pilot allegedly attempted to stab the other and crash the aircraft. Israeli officials are investigating the diversion as a potential attack or hijacking attempt.

stories.title: Après la tentative de détournement d’un avion de Flydubai volant vers Tel-Aviv, des témoignages et des zones d’ombre

en.title: Following Flydubai hijacking attempt on Tel Aviv flight, testimonies and unresolved questions
en.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after one pilot stabbed another. Israeli authorities are investigating whether the incident was a terrorist attack, suicide attempt, or other motivated act.

stories.title: Vol dérouté, pilotes blessés, piste terroriste évoquée... Ce que l'on sait de l'atterrissage d'urgence d'un avion FlyDubai à destination de Tel-Aviv

en.title: Diverted flight, injured pilots, terrorist plot mentioned... What we know about the emergency landing of a FlyDubai plane bound for Tel-Aviv
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft from Dubai to Tel-Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday morning. The Israeli government characterized the incident as an attempted jihadist terrorist attack.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct - vol de Flydubai dérouté : l'un des pilotes a tenté de faire s'écraser l'avion, selon Netanyahu

en.title: Live - Flydubai flight diverted: one pilot attempted to crash the plane, according to Netanyahu
en.summary: A Flydubai flight was diverted after one pilot allegedly attempted to crash the aircraft, according to Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu.

stories.title: La Navy choisit Boeing pour son F/A-XX

en.title: Navy selects Boeing for its F/A-XX
en.summary: The US Navy selected Boeing as prime contractor for developing the F/A-XX fighter to replace its F-18 fleet. Boeing is already supplying the F-47 to the US Air Force.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : les chiffres toujours plus inquiétants des finances publiques

en.title: Budget 2027: increasingly concerning figures for public finances
en.summary: France's debt has surpassed 3,500 billion euros, representing 119% of GDP. Rising interest rates driven by Middle Eastern energy tensions are expected to significantly increase interest charges by 2030.

en.title: Sabena Aerospace opens its capital
en.summary: Investment firm Andera Partners has decided to acquire a stake in Belgian aerospace maintenance company Sabena Engineering to support its expansion.

en.title: Among Green senators, a "no" to LFI not as consensual as all that
en.summary: Green Party senators have declined to admit Gabriel Amard, a senator from La France insoumise, into their parliamentary group due to lack of consensus.

stories.title: Budget : « L’état de nervosité des marchés se matérialise par l’écart de taux entre la France et l’Allemagne »

en.title: Budget: "Market nervousness is reflected in the interest rate spread between France and Germany"
en.summary: ING Belgium's chief strategist was interviewed to explain market sentiment and expectations regarding the government's upcoming budget presentation.
